message:
chore(release): 0.2.110 -- the first release that carries a new updater

Windows only; Android untouched, since nothing in it changed and a bumped number
that describes no change stops being evidence.

GNLinkUpdater.exe is 538,624 bytes where 0.2.109 had 532,480 -- the stop and
relaunch fixes are in it, and this is the first release whose manifest names it,
so the first that can ever replace it.

The manifest generator no longer writes the artifact list down. It reads
product_payload_names(). 0.2.109 went out without GNLinkSetup.exe precisely
because that script held its own copy of the list and the copy was wrong; the
publish-time gate catches that from one side, and this removes the gap from the
other. One source for the list.

The backup guard earned itself in production on this publish: manifest-backups
already had 0.2.109, so the pair being replaced went to a timestamped path and
the original first-publish pair stayed put. Without it the rollback point would
have been overwritten by the very thing you would roll back from.

One defect found while publishing: in a dry run, verify_on_server skipped every
artifact that was not uploaded yet and then reported "all 10 artifacts on the
server match" -- claiming ten checks after doing none. It now counts what it
actually checked. That is the third summary line this round that did not describe
the work it had just done.

Still unverified and not claimed: a real host taking this end to end. The
installed 0.2.108 updater contains none of these fixes and has never been
replaced by any release, so one manual installer run has to come first.
